a_record_this_corrects.the_reading_now: cross-source-read.json is regenerated by tools/read_statement_facts.py. 79 of its 80 (read, verdict) pairs are what they were; Salesforce B03 reads 0.2295243829018663455749548465 - the published value, because the reader now sees the same fact the route took - and its verdict is DIRECT_CANDIDATES_DISAGREE, so a reader that agrees with the route still does not accept it. Agreement between two readers that both follow the chain says nothing about what the chain's first concept covers.
a_record_this_corrects.what_is_true: the primary document tags it (f-792 to f-794, one sentence in the property and equipment note). The earlier reading's code was never committed; its working copy, found in the session's scratch area, parsed each value with int() and skipped whatever failed. '1.2' at scale 9 fails int(), so the fact was invisible and the reading followed the chain to DepreciationAndAmortization. tools/read_statement_facts.py now produces that reading from committed code, parses decimals, and re-derives every other position unchanged.
a_record_this_corrects.what_the_error_cost: a subtotal taken as the total was written up as the route being right. It is the shape this issue keeps meeting - not having seen something recorded as its not being there - and here it also turned a defect into a vindication.
a_record_this_corrects.what_was_recorded: cross-source-read.json and the acceptance register's not_here_and_why said the primary document tags DepreciationAndAmortization and not DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization, that the accession's facts carry the latter, and that 'the route followed the definition and the reading could not'. AGENTS.md repeated it: '路线是对的，我的读法够不到'.

finding.only_filing_affected_in_this_frame: in the other eight B03 filings the chain takes the only direct candidate, or two that agree (Lumen tags DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization and DepreciationAndAmortization both at 2,749,000,000), and the words beside it are a statement line 'Depreciation and amortization' - Ford's is its segment note's consolidated 'Depreciation and tooling amortization' total of $15,974 million, which includes Ford Credit's depreciation on vehicles subject to operating leases. Marriott's two years use the approved composition.
finding.what_the_chain_takes: DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization 1,200,000,000 (f-792, decimals -8), tagged in the property and equipment note: 'Depreciation and amortization of fixed assets totaled $1.2 billion, $1.0 billion and $1.1 billion during fiscal 2026, 2025 and 2024'.
finding.what_the_filing_reports_as_the_total: DepreciationAndAmortization 3,631,000,000 (f-320), the cash flow statement's 'Depreciation and amortization (1)', footnoted: 'Includes amortization of intangible assets acquired through business combinations, depreciation of fixed assets and amortization and impairment of right-of-use assets.'
finding.what_the_right_value_is_not_yet: the statement total cannot simply replace it. It also carries amortization and impairment of right-of-use assets, and the definition says '不加回 impairment'; the filing does not tag the year's right-of-use impairment separately (restructuring of $586 million is tagged, not split). No approved composition applies either: the filing tags neither us-gaap:Depreciation nor us-gaap:AmortizationOfIntangibleAssets undimensioned for the year.
finding.what_the_taken_fact_leaves_out: amortization of intangible assets acquired through business combinations - $692 million in cost of revenues and $995 million in sales and marketing, from the filing's own footnote to the statement of operations - so $1,687 million the definition's 'depreciation and amortization' includes.
finding.why_it_is_a_defect_and_not_a_reading_cho: the standing rule is that a subtotal is not taken as a complete total, and a concept name is a clue, not proof of what a number covers. The filing itself says what this fact covers. Under the definition's formula (operating income + depreciation and amortization) / revenue, 0.2295 counts fixed-asset depreciation only.

options.cost: takes fixed-asset depreciation as total D&A - a subtotal as the total, which the standing rules forbid.
adds back amortization and impairment of right-of-use assets; the definition says impairment is not added back, and the year's amount is not separately tagged.

a guard the approved Spec does not have: when the filing tags more than one direct D&A concept for the period and they carry different values, neither is taken. Lumen, where they agree, is unaffected; Salesforce withholds. It changes the approved selection rule, so it goes through the revision mechanism.
